q: Should an MSME choose a green loan or a sustainability-linked loan?
title: Green loan or sustainability-linked loan
short: Choose a green loan when the money is for a specific project such as solar, efficient motors or a cleaner boiler. Choose a sustainability-linked loan when you want general funding tied to company-wide targets like emissions intensity. Many MSMEs start with a green loan.
audience: MSME owners and finance heads comparing climate-linked finance options

ul: Money used only for named green projects.
Reporting on how the money was spent and the impact.
Easier to start with one clear project.
Interest linked to KPIs such as emissions per tonne.
Needs a baseline, yearly reporting and usually external verification.

p: If you do not yet track emissions monthly, a sustainability-linked loan is hard to run. A green loan for one project builds the records you would need later.

senseible: Senseible turns invoices and bills into dated, fingerprinted emission records, the evidence a lender usually asks to see first.
